candidates.summary: The IAEA said external power was restored to Ukraine's Russian-controlled Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant on November 8, hours after the Ferosplavna line disconnected and emergency diesel generators supplied reactor cooling. The agency said the cause and location of the disconnection were unknown and described it as the plant's 27th loss of off-site electricity since the invasion. Russian-installed management reported normal radiation levels. The main Dniprovska power line remained unavailable, according to the IAEA's latest cited assessment.
candidates.title: IAEA reports power restored to Zaporizhzhia after outage

candidates.summary: Nvidia's board announced on November 8 an independent investigation following reports that CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the inquiry. The board said it had no reason to believe that U.S. national security or Nvidia secrets had been compromised, expressed confidence in Huang and his leadership team, and said Huang supported the review and would cooperate. The announcement did not establish the underlying espionage allegations.
candidates.title: Nvidia board announces independent review of reported intelligence targeting of Huang

candidates.summary: A high-rise building fire broke out in Taiyuan's Yingze district at 4:59 p.m. local time on November 8. Reuters, citing Chinese state media, reported that firefighters extinguished the flames roughly two hours later and rescue operations concluded at 8:30 p.m., with 38 people taken to hospital. Five deaths were initially confirmed late Sunday; reporting available before the coverage cutoff put the toll at 14. The cause was under investigation.
candidates.title: Taiyuan high-rise fire kills 14, state media report

candidates.summary: In a November 8 CNN interview, President Donald Trump said renewed U.S. attacks on Iran were unlikely to be necessary if Tehran signed a strong agreement, while retaining the option of military action. Later Sunday, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said a diplomatic breakthrough was not imminent and described talks as unproductive because of Iranian demands. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said mediator travel had stopped after the U.S. elections and that Iran's existing proposal remained available subject to its conditions. None of these statements announced an agreement or resumed negotiations.
candidates.title: Rubio says Iran breakthrough is not imminent after Trump's conditional comments on strikes

candidates.summary: Speaking to reporters in Florida on November 8, President Donald Trump said he had been joking when he announced the previous day that he had offered UFC chief Dana White the White House press secretary position. His remarks clarified the earlier social-media announcement; they did not announce an appointment.
candidates.title: Trump says Dana White press secretary offer was a joke
candidates.geography: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States

candidates.summary: Iranian state news agency IRNA reported four explosions on Qeshm Island on the evening of November 8. Its correspondent said some areas appeared to have been struck by projectiles. The cause and nature of the explosions were not confirmed. The report concerned Sunday evening, separate from explosions reported on Saturday; it did not establish a new U.S. strike.
candidates.title: Iranian state media report new explosions on Qeshm Island
